title: Fix scratch-vector aliasing in advance/solveCollisions
description: Correctness (parent cell-8kf). In advance() normal and normal2 are both this._v1 (the same Vector3 object) and _v6 is reused for cell a then b in solveCollisions()'s two deflectHeading calls. This is correct only by call ordering; reordering silently corrupts vectors. Give each a dedicated scratch vector (or local Vector3). Verify no behavior change; build + headless slow range unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Build passes; no behavior change; scratch vectors no longer aliased.

title: Perf + time-driven sim pass: drop transmission, split sensing, accumulator stepping, far-side culling
description: Four changes, no behavior loss (eating + slowing preserved): (1) Remove glassy transmission -> swap cell body to MeshStandardMaterial (sim.js createCell; drop transmission cleanup in updateMito). (2) Split senseAndAbsorb into per-substep tight eatAndRespawn (tight grid scan, tracking respawning foods via a list) + throttled concentration (wide scan computes slow/foodAmt/foodPeak/foodDir every SENSE_PERIOD=0.05 sim-sec via an accumulator). (3) App.vue accumulator loop: measure real clock between render frames (performance.now - lastTime), step physics to match wall-clock x simSpeed with a MAX_BACKLOG cap; use sim.step()/sim.render() split. (4) Far-side culling: hide cells/tails on the occluded hemisphere (CULL_COS) via updateVisibility(); zero tail matrices for hidden cells. New constants SENSE_PERIOD, CULL_COS. Verify build + headless slow-range unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes; headless sim still shows slow-down 0.02..1.0 and eating still grows cells; far-side cells not drawn; transmission removed.
close_reason: Completed and verified headless (30 sim-s no renderer: eating grows cells, slow range 0.02..1.0, mitosis to 121 cells, 210 foods queued to respawn). Transmission removed; sensing split (eat per-substep + throttled concentration); accumulator time-stepping; far-side culling.

title: Fix sim speed via fixed-timestep substep loop
description: Increasing simSpeed paradoxically slowed the sim: a single large physics step per frame over-damped the exp(-DRAG*simDt) integration. Replaced Simulation.step with frame(simDt,tail) that subdivides simDt into clamp(ceil(simDt/FIXED_DT),1,MAX_STEPS) substeps; split updateFood into buildFoodGrid (once/frame) + senseAndAbsorb (per substep); moved tails into renderTails (once/frame). Verified linear speedup + npm run build.
close_reason: Fixed; build green; verified linear speedup

Depends on cell-8kf.5.1 and cell-8kf.5.2. Build passes; behavior identical.

Extract src/food.js (foodGrid, eatAndRespawn, concentration, clumps, add/removeFoodFromGrid) and src/cells.js (createCell, growCell, mitose, placeTail, updateTailState, updateMito), leaving sim.js as orchestrator. Behavior identical; build passes.

title: Refactor sim.js: dedup food scans, fix scratch-vector aliasing, pool capsule geometry
description: Follow-up (discovered-from cell-4k6). (1) Correctness: normal/normal2 both alias this._v1 in advance() (lines ~900/937) and _v6 is reused for a then b in solveCollisions; correct only by ordering - give them dedicated scratch vectors. (2) Dedup: extract foodCapsuleDist() from the duplicated capsule->food distance block in eatAndRespawn (~621-633) and concentration (~675-687); extract a forEachNearbyFood(cx,cy,cz,radius,cb) scanner for the 3x3x3 and 5x5x5 loops; extract clearTail(cell) for the tail-matrix zeroing duplicated in placeTail hidden branch and removeCell. (3) Perf: setCellAppearance mixes geometry+nucleus+color and disposes/recreates CapsuleGeometry on every eat; split into updateGeometry/updateColor and pool pre-built capsule geometries by length bucket. Behavior must stay identical; verify build + headless slow range.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes; headless slow range 0.02..1.0 unchanged; no measureable behavior change.

title: Model tail with lagged trailing + agitation thrust
description: Rewrite tail model in src/sim.js (placeTail) and src/constants.js. Axis 1 (B): give each cell a lagged surface-tangent tailDir that chases -heading with damping so the tail trails through the medium instead of being pinned rigidly in the body frame (snaps on turns today). Axis 2 (D+E): add a discrete agitate decision (attack/release) plus a whip transient on 'go', and blend a planar beat into a helical corkscrew when agitated. Keep everything on the sphere, TAIL_SEGMENTS loop intact, no per-cell rope sim.
acceptance_criteria: Tails lag behind turns and stop lagging behind the head; tails visibly agitate + coil (helix) when a bacterium accelerates away; performance unchanged; npm run build passes.
close_reason: Implemented B (lagged surface-tangent tailDir trails through medium) + D (discrete agitate with attack/release + whip transient on GO_THRESH) + E (planar->helical corkscrew under agitation). placeTail/updateTailState rewritten; new constants; userData extended; DESIGN.md updated; npm run build passes.

title: Split App.vue into modular source files

notes: Split 916-line App.vue monolith into modules: constants.js, math.js, materials.js, sceneSetup.js, sim.js (Simulation class). App.vue is now a thin Vue shell (lifecycle + time scaling + reactive UI). Fragile this-based placeMitoChild now takes an explicit mito param; removed unused _v5 temp. Build passes (npm run build). Updated docs/DESIGN.md and AGENTS.md structure notes.

title: Pool pre-built capsule geometries by length bucket
description: Perf (parent cell-8kf.4). growCell disposes and re-creates a CapsuleGeometry every eat (allocation churn). Cache prebuilt CapsuleGeometry per quantized length bucket (e.g. round radius to ~5 steps) and reuse; dispose only on reset. Identical look; build passes; reduces GC.
